summary: Silkroad Online entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Silkroad Online
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Windows PC service, with server/account/build state documented

emulation.notes: Use official PC service where available; private servers are separate routes.

primary.version: Current official Joymax/Wemade Max PC service where available
primary.why: Silkroad Online is a live/regional MMORPG with service, publisher, monetization, and server-state caveats. The archive route should prefer official PC service access and document server/account state; private servers and mobile licensed games are separate routes.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official PC client where available. Record launcher/source, region, server, build/date, account, character race/build, job state, guild/PvP state, queue/VIP or monetization state, and whether mobile or private-server routes were compared.

secondary.platform: Silkroad Origin Mobile / other licensed mobile versions
secondary.what_to_play: Use separately if documenting mobile versions.
secondary.why: They are not the original PC MMORPG service.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only as a clearly labeled preservation/community route.
secondary.why: Official service state is the primary archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original and continuing official PC MMORPG route.

all_releases.platform: Silkroad Origin Mobile / mobile licensed routes

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Official service access, region, queue/VIP state, monetization, and private/mobile variants all change the route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record launcher/source, region, server, account, build, job/PvP state, and monetization/queue state.
